title: A complete characterization of sequential testability and change detectability in i.i.d. models
abstract: arXiv:2609.05752v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We give qualitative and quantitative necessary and sufficient conditions for sequential testing and change detection in an i.i.d. composite problem. A level-\(\alpha\) test with power one against every alternative exists if and only if the alternatives are separated from the null by a countable family of finite-block events. Equivalent conditions use randomized tests, bounded scores, e-processes, reduced-filtration test supermartingales, and a countable cover with positive finite-block weak-$*$ convex-hull separation. The construction gives pointwise expected sample size \(O_Q(\log(1/\alpha))\). Quantitatively, one e-process attains the intrinsic pointwise growth rate \(\Gamma(Q)\) at every alternative if and only if a countable family of bounded block bets recovers these rates. The same condition characterizes simultaneous attainment of the sharp expected-sample-size coefficient \(1/\Gamma(Q)\); arbitrary attainable lower rate

translated_title: i.i.d.模型中序列可检验性与变化可检测性的完整刻画
translated_abstract: 我们在i.i.d.复合假设检验问题中给出了序列检验与变化检测的定性和定量充要条件。当且仅当备择假设能被一族可数的有限块事件与原假设分离时，才存在对所有备择假设功效为1的水平为α的检验。等价条件可通过随机化检验、有界得分、e-过程、缩减过滤的检验上鞅，以及具有正有限块弱*凸包分离的可数覆盖来表述。该构造给出了逐点期望样本量 O_Q(log(1/α))。在定量层面，存在一个e-过程在每个备择假设处达到内在逐点增长率 Γ(Q)，当且仅当一族可数的有界块赌注能够恢复这些增长率。同样的条件刻画了能否同时达到最优的期望样本量系数 1/Γ(Q)；以及任意可实现的下增长率（的刻画）。
tldr: 该论文首次对i.i.d.复合模型中的序列检验与变化检测给出了完整刻画：可检验性当且仅当备择假设可被可数族有限块事件分离，而可数族有界块赌注能否恢复内在增长率则决定了最优e-过程及最优期望样本量系数1/Γ(Q)能否同时达到。
en_tdlr: This paper provides a complete characterization of sequential testability and change detectability in i.i.d. composite models: testability holds if and only if alternatives are separated by a countable family of finite-block events, and the recoverability of intrinsic growth rates by countable bounded block bets determines whether optimal e-processes and the sharp expected-sample-size coefficient 1/Γ(Q) can be simultaneously attained.
